pro_course_detail.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you since I am American and English is my first language. My Spanish is near-native. That means that I'm not just fluent in Spanish, but quite often I am mistaken for a native speaker and because of how well I speak and interact in Spanish many natives are surprised that I'm American. 

Since there are so many native Spanish speakers on italki, why take classes with me?  Sooner or later there will be some expressions, concepts or ideas that you will not be able to either understand or express. A native Spanish speaker won't necessarily be able to explain this and help you to clear up your confusion on the subject the way I can. Sometimes a hundred examples just doesn't help you to know how to say something. As a speaker of English I usually anticipate what my students are trying to say. My classes are extremely productive. 

I have been a translator and interpreter for over 20 years. I've lived in Spain, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Costa Rica and Panama.  So not only do I speak Spanish almost like a native, but I'm familiar with some of the accents and vocabulary differences that you might come across from country to country. 

It's a great language. It's fun to learn, but it does take work.  Why not try some classes with me. I know you'll enjoy them.

I prefer to speak Spanish in the class. I will slow it down if you need that. I will make sure you understand me and slowly increase the speed over time as your comprehension increases. If you insist I will be happy to speak some English in the class to guide you and explain some grammar rules if need be.

Struggling with speaking? Little to no opportunity to practice? Not enough people around to help you with day-to-day conversations? Don't worry, I've got you covered. Throughout this class, we’ll dive into a bunch of exciting topics, with a focus on helping you:

This lesson type is designed to strengthen your reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills for Dutch language exams, ensuring that you are fully prepared and have the best chance of passing any exam.

What does this lesson cover?

✅ Reading: Improve your ability to comprehend Dutch texts, focusing on exam-related topics and question types.
✅ Writing: Develop your writing skills, practicing structured responses, essays, and other exam tasks.
✅ Listening: Enhance your listening skills through targeted exercises and exam-style listening activities.
